Paragraf: Penelitian variasi bahasa pada lanskap linguistik di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya dilatarbelakangi fenomena bahasa tulis yang terdapat di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya. Adanya variasi bahasa tidak menghilangkan fungsi dari lanskap linguistik. Lanskap linguistik memberikan informasi kepada wisatawan yang berkunjung ke Candi Mendut. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk (1) menemukan bentuk variasi bahasa kajian lanskap linguistik di sekitar Candi Mendut, dan (2) menemukan fungsi lanskap linguistik di sekitar Candi Mendut. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan tipe deskriptif. Data penelitian berupa kata, frasa, klausa, dan wacana. Pengumpulan data menggunakan teknik observasi dan dokumentasi. Adapun analisis data menggunakan teknik Bagi Unsur Langsung (BUL). Hasil penelitian ditemukan variasi bahasa pada lanskap linguistik di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya berupa monolingualisme, bilingualisme, dan multilingualisme. Adapun fungsi lanskap linguistik yang ditemukan berupa fungsi informasi dan fungsi simbolis. Berdasarkan hasil penelitian, variasi bahasa pada lanskap linguistik yang paling banyak digunakan di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya ialah bentuk variasi bilingualisme bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris. Fungsi lanskap linguistik yang ditemukan berupa fungsi informasi yang meliputi larangan, imbauan, petunjuk arah, dan nama tempat. Fungsi simbolis meliputi relasi kebudayaan, relasi politik, dan relasi ekonomi.
Judul: SKRIPSI VARIASI BAHASA PADA LANSKAP DI SEKITAR CANDI MENDUT
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: Candi Mendut, fungsi lanskap linguistik, variasi bahasa

Paragraf: Sambungan dalam dunia industri digunakan untuk menggabungkan dua material atau lebih. Sambungan mekanik dilakukan dengan berbagai metode yaitu,pengelasan, rivet, baut dan adhesive bonding (perekat). Sambungan perekat merupakan salah satu metode yang efektif dalam membuat ikatan dua suatu material. Metode ini lebih efektif dibandingkan dengan metode penyambungan yang lain seperti sambungan paku keling, sambungan las dan sambungan baut. ketika terjadi kerusakan, mudah korosi, harus dilakukannya perawatan khusus. Kebutuhan industri menuntut untuk mendapatkan sambungan yang kuat dan ekonomis mendorong banyak peneliti untuk mendapatkan metode alternatif. Penggunaan adhesive menjadi alternatif dalam rekayasa yang menghasilkan struktur yang ringan. Adhesive bonding adalah proses penyatuan dua permukaan dengan menciptakan ikatan yang halus. Adapun akan akan dilakukan penelitian peningkatan kekuatan mekanik sambungan tumpang tunggal dengan mixed adhesive – getah pinus dengan variasi campuran 100 % : 0 % , 90% : 10%, 80 % : 20 % , 75 % : 25 % pada similar material baja ST 37. Pengujian tarik dari variasi campuran a, b, c dan d mengalami peningkatan maximum force. Sedangkan untuk kekuatan tarik mengalami penurunan yang signifikan dimana kekuatan tarik variasi 100% EP : 0 % GP sebesar 0,263 Mpa, untuk variasi ini mendapatkan nilai yang tertinggi dan kekuatan Tarik dengan nilai terendah dihasilkan pada variasi 70 % EP : 30 % GP dengan nilai 0,0092 Mpa.
Judul: SKRIPSI KARAKTERISTIK KEKUATAN MEKANIK SAMBUNGAN TUMPANG TUNGGAL DENGAN MIXED ADHESIVE PADA SIMILAR MATERIAL BAJA ST 37
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci : adhesive bonding, Baja ST 37, Uji Tarik.

Paragraf: Sumber Energi Terbarukan (EBT) harus lah dapat dimanfaatkan dengan baik, sebagai upaya untuk mengurangi krisis energi dan dampak polusi. Salah satunya dengan mengembangkan Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Mikro Hidro (PLTMH). Jenis turbin yang yang berpotensi untuk pembuatan PLTMH pada sungai-sungai di Indonesia yaitu turbin ulir. Tujuan dari penilitian ini yaitu untuk mengetahui performa dari turbin ulir dengan menggunakan variasi sudut kemiringan poros turbin dengan variasi sudutnya yaitu 32°, 36°, 40° dan 44°. Hasil penilitian ini menunjukan bahwa sudut kemiringan poros turbin dapat mempengaruhi kinerja turbin ulir. Hasi yang diperoleh menunujukan kemiringan poros turbin dengan sudut 32° mendapatkan performa yang maksimal dengan nilai torsi sebesar 0,930 Nm, daya yang dihasilkan yaitu 33,085 Watt, dan efisiensinya yaitu 87%. Untuk hasil terendah didapatkan pada variasi sudut 44° dengan torsi yang diahsilkan yaitu 0,702 Nm , daya sebesar 23,034 Watt dan efisiensinya 51%. Renewable Energy Sources (EBT) must be utilized properly, as an effort to reduce the energy crisis and the impact of pollution. One of his effort can be done is developing a Micro Hydro Power Plant (MHP). The type of turbine that has the potential for making MHP on rivers in Indonesia is the screw turbine. The aim of this research is to determine the performance of a screw turbine using variations in the tilt angle of the turbine shaft with variations the angles are 32°, 36°, 40° and 44°. The results of this research show that the inclination angle of the turbine shaft can affect the performance of the screw turbine. The results obtained show that tilting the turbine shaft at an angle of 32° achieves maximum performance with a torque value of 0.930 Nm, the power produced is 33.085 Watts, and the efficiency is 87%. The lowest results were obtained at a 44° angle variation with the resulting torque being 0.702 Nm, power of 23.034 Watts and efficiency of 51%.
Judul: SKRIPSI KAJI EKSPERIMENTAL PENGARUH VARIASI SUDUT KEMIRINGAN POROS TERHADAP EFISIENSI PADA TURBIN ULIR TIPE DOUBLE BLADE
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: archimedes screw, EBT, PLTMH, turbin ulir. | Keywords:archimedes screw, MHP, renewable energy, screw turbine.

Paragraf: Pakan ternak dibutuhkan oleh semua jenis hewan ruminansia. Adanya alat pembuat pakan permen ternak otomatis yang belum mempunyai nilai tekanan menjadi permasalahan dalam memperoleh kualitas permen ternak yang diinginkan. Tujuan dari penelitian ini adalah meningkatkan produktivitas pembuatan permen ternak melalui pengaruh variasi tekanan terhadap kapasitas mesin prees pneumatik yang dihasilkan, serta densitas dan kadar air yang dihasilkan dari variasi tekanan pengepresan. Metode penelitian yang digunakan antara lain : Studi Literatur, Metode Observasi Lapangan, Bimbingan, Analisis. Variasi tekanan yang digunakan pada setiap pengepresan pada alat ini adalah 6 kgf/cm2, 8 kgf/cm2, dan 10 kgf/cm2. Motor listrik pada kompresor yang digunakan mempunyai daya sebesar 2 HP dengan putaran mesin 2800 rpm. Hasil penelitian ini adalah dari ketiga variasi tersebut yang menghasilkan massa jenis pada saat pengepresan adalah variasi tekanan sebesar 10 kgf/cm2 dengan massa jenis rata-rata sebesar 0,861 gr/cm3. Waktu pengerjaan selama satu siklus pada proses pengepresan menunjukkan bahwa 1 produk permen ternak membutuhkan waktu 2 menit.
Judul: SKRIPSI RANCANG BANGUN MESIN PRESS OTOMATIS KONSENTRAT PERMEN TERNAK BERBASIS SISTEM PNEUMATIK
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci : Pengepresan, Permen ternak, Pneumatik, Produktivitas, Variasi Tekanan

Paragraf: A study on the use of ""Tabur-C"" fertilezer as a substitution for SP-36 in a fertilization package recommendation in the rice intensification program was undertaken to find out the optimal dose of ""Tabur-C fertilizer, in order to determine its feasibility as an alternative fertilizer. The experiment was conducted from May to September 1999 in Krengseng village, Batang district, Central Java provinci, on a latosol soil, 10 meters above sea level and type of climate according to Schmid and Fergusson clasification system is C. Ther were seven treatments of rice fertilization package, replicated four time and arranged in a randomized complete block, design. The treatmens consist of fertilizer dose recommended by food-crop service fertilizer dose applied by local farmers, and five levels of fertilizer dose of Tabur-C and its combination with SP-36 in the recommended fertilization package. The results of this experiment showed that Tabur-C fertilizer affected the weight of I 000 dry grains and the grain yield, but it did not affect the other growth components. The rice fertilization package using the lowest dose of phosphate did not inhibit the growth of rice plant. Four hundred kilograms Tabur C per hektare, which was in one fertilization package with recommended dose of Urea, ZA, and KCl, produced the highest grain yield and showed the largestrofit. Based on the results, it could be concluded that Tabur-C fertilizer is feasible to apply as on alternative of SP-36 fertilizer in a fertilization recommendation package in the rice intensification program.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGGUNAAN PUPUK TABUR-C SEBAGAI SUBTITUSI PUPUK SP 36 DALAM PAKET REKOMENDASI PEMUPUKAN PADA PROGRAM INTENSIFIKASI PADA SAWAH (Oryza sativia, L)

Paragraf: Dalam rangka penyelenggaraan pemerintahan, pelayanan kepada masyarakat dan pelaksanaan pembangunan maka pemerintah pada hakekatnya mengemban dua fungsi yaitu fungsi distribusi yang meliputi distribusi pendapatan dan kekayaan masyarakat serta pemerataan pembangunan. Fungsi yang kedua adalah fungsi stabilisasi yang meliputi diantaranya stabilisasi sumber-sumber ekonomi dalam bentuk barang dan jasa serta pelayanan masyarakat. Di dalam mendukung penyelenggaraan otonomi daerah diperlukan kewenangan di daerah yang diujudkan dengan pembagian dan pemanfaatan sumber dana nasional yang berkeadilan sosial serta perimbangan keuangan pemerintah daerah dan pemerintah pusat yang dilaksanakan atas dasar asas desentralisasi, dekonsentrasi dan tugas pembantuan. Tipe penelitian yang digunakan adalah penelitian eksplanatori dengan teknik pengambilan data observasi, wawancara dan kuesioner. Populasi penelitian adalah pegawai di kantor Dinas Pendidikan Nasional Kabupaten Banjarnegara dengan sampel sebesar 30 orang. Teknik pengambilan sampel adalah random sampling. Teknik pengolahan data dengan menggunakan uji statistika yaitu product moment, korelasi partial, korelasi majemuk atau ganda dan korelasi determinasi Penelitian ini memberikan hasil sebagai berikut: 1. Terdapat pengaruh motivasi kerja terhadap prestasi kerja dengan r korelasi sebesar 0,577. Dengan demikian semakin tinggi motivasi kerja maka semakin tinggi pula prestasi kerja. 2. Terdapat pengaruh koordinasi terhadap prestasi kerja dengan r korelasi sebesar 0,866. Dengan demikian semakin baik koordinasi maka semakin tinggi prestasi kerja. 3. Terdapat pengaruh pengawasan terhadap prestasi kerja dengan r korelasi sebesar 0,635. Dengan demikian semakin baik pengawasan maka semakin tinggi pula prestasi kerja. 4. Terdapat pengaruh motivasi kerja, koordinasi dan pengawasan secara bersama-sama terhadap prestasi kerja dengan r korelasi sebesar 1,092. Uji signifikansi menggunakan rumus F test diperoleh hasil hitung 161,41 ( lebi besar dari F tabel 2,77). Dengan demikian ke tiga independent variabel secara bersama-sama mempunyai pengaruh atas prestasi kerja pegawai. 5. Variabel motivasi kerja, koordinasi dan pengawasan mempengaruhi prestasi kerja sebesar 89,7%. Dengan demikian selebihnya yaitu 10,3% dipengaruhi oleh variabel lain diluar variabel penelitian. Pada bagian akhir laporan penelitian ini penulis memberikan saran-saran yaitu peningkatan prestasi kerja pegawai dapat diupayakan melalui koordinasi kerja yang lebih baik dan pengawasan yang tidak terlalu berlebihan atas kerja pegawai. Di samping itu penulis memberikan rekomendasi untuk melakukan penelitian lanjutan terhadap prestasi kerja pegawai dengan menggunakan variabel bebas diluar variabel penelitian ini seperti pelatihan dan perbaikan lingkungan kerja.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH MOTIVASI KERJA, KOORDINASI DAN PENGAWASAN TERHADAP PRESENTASI KERJA PEGAWAI DI KANTOR DINAS PENDIDIKAN NASIONAL KABUPATEN BANJARNEGARA

Paragraf: A research entitled The Effect of Kalium and Lime Dose on Yield of Soybean (Glycine max, L. Merrill) Ringgit variety, was conducted from 10 September, 1997 to 27 December 1997. Paragraf: Campur tangan dan perencanaan pemerintah penting sekali di dalam menciptakan pembangunan di negara sedang berkembang. Dalam rangka menyelenggarakan pemerintahan, pelayanan masyarakat dan pembangunan maka pemerintah perlu meningkatkan kualitas dari masyarakatnya. Khususnya pada suatu organisasi pemerintah atau swasta, perlu adanya upaya peningkatan prestasi kerja pegawai. Yang akan di dapat jika dipengaruhi oleh adanya pembagian kerja yang tepat sasaran, adanya pengawasan yang terpadu dari seorang pimpinan kepada para pegawainya dan adanya motivas pegawai untuk bekerja lebih baik dari hari sebelumnya, baik timbul dari kesadaran dari dalam diri pegawai atau dari usaha rangsangan dari pimpinan kepada para pegawainya. Adapun tujuan penelitian ini adalah untuk menguraikan apa yang menjadi sasaran serta harapun yang akan didapat dengan dilaksanakannya penelitian di Kantor Kecamatan Mungkid Kabupaten Magelang. Tipe penelitian yang digunakan adalah penelitian eksploratif sedangkan alat pengambilan data dengan menggunakan teknik observasi dan quesioner. Populasi sampling meliputi semua pegawai pada Kantor Kecamatan Mungkid Kabupaten Magelang. Sumber data adalah sumber data sekunder, untuk menganalisa dan pengujian hipotesa digunakan rumus statistk product moment, korelasi partial, korelasi majemuk atau ganda, serta korelasi determinasi Ftest, 1. Tidak ada pengaruh yang signifikan antara variabel pembagian kerja dengan prestasi kerja pegawai, hal ini terbukti dengan perbandingan antara Fay yang lehih kecil dari r-tabel 5% atau (0,27 0,433) 2. Terdapat pengarah yang sangat signifikan antara variabel pengawasın dengan prestasi kerja pegawai, hal ini terbukti dengan perbandingan x, yang lebih besar dari 1-tabel 5% atau (0,0126-2.38). 3. Tidak ada pengaruh yang signifikan antara variabel motivasi kerja dengan prestasi kerja pegawai, hal ini terbukti dengan perbandingan antara ro, yang lebih kecil duri r-tabel 5% atau (0,17-0,433) 4. Tidak ada pengaruh yang murni antara variabel pembagian kerja dengan prestasi kerja pegawai meskipun telah dikontrol variabel motivasi kerja setelah diuji memperoleh hasil Frest lebih kecil dari r-tabel (0,57-2.38) 5. Tidak ada pengaruh yang murni antara variabel pengawasan dengan prestasi kerja meskipun telah dikontrol variabel pembagian kerja, setelah diuji memperoleh hasil Flest lebih kecil dari r-tabel (0,0126-2.38) 6. Ada pengaruh yang murni antars variabel pembagian kerja dengan prestasi kerja pegawai meskipun telah dikontrol secara bersama-sama olek variabe pengawasan dan motivasi kerja, setelah diuji memperoleh hasil Frest lebih besar dari pada 1-tabel (6,122.38) 7. Ada pengaruh yang murni antara variabel pembagian kerja, pengawasan dan motivasi kerja secara bersama-sama terhadap prestasi kerja pegawai, setelah diuji memperoleh hasil Ftest lebih besar dari pada 1-tabel (19,1>2.38) 8. Menguji hempa presentase (%) pengaruh pembagian kerja, pengawasan dan motivasi kerja secara bersama-sama terhadap prestasi kerja pegawai adalah 86. Hal ini berarti bahwa 14% lainnya adalah dipengaruhi oleh faktor-faktor lain diluar penelitian, yang juga mempunyai pengaruh terhadap prestasi kerja pegawai itu sendiri
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH PEMBAGIAN KERJA, PENGAWASAN DAN MOTIVASI KERJA TERHADAP PRESTASI KERJA PEGAWAI DI KANTOR KECAMATAN MUNGKID KABUPATEN MAGELANG

Paragraf: The experiment about the effect of kinds of organic fertilizer and variety on yield of cabbage plant (Brassica oleraceae, L.), had been carried out since March until June 1999 at Ngadipuro, Dukun Sub District, Magelang District, Central Java. The soil is latosol with pH 6,0 and the altitude 500 meters. The method of experiment is factorial with completely randomized design, consist of two factors and three replications. The first factor is variety, King (F1 Hybrid), TOTO 101 (F1 Hybrid) and 633 (F1 Hybrid). The second factor is kinds of organic fertilizer of compost fertilizer, INRA fertilizer and litter. The result of experiment shows that The TOTO 101 variety gives the highest yield on weight of crop, leaf area, fresh weight of straw and dry weight of straw. Litter with variety TOTO 101 tends to have the highest yield on weight of crop that is 2066,93 gram and organic fertilizer of compost with variety King tends to have the lowest yield on weight of crop that is 1316,96 g.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH MACAM PUPUK ORGANIK DAN VARITAS TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN KOBIS (Brassica oleraceae, L.)

Paragraf: The study to know correlation of The Brownepot (Helminthosporium oryzae) intensity to yield of rice field (Oryza sativa) was conducted in Food Crop Pest and Disease Observation Laboratory for region Kedu in Temanggung, Cen- tral Java, on January April 1992. The first factor is variation inoculum consentration (I) namely Con- trol (I), 106cel conidia/ml (I1), and 1012cel conidia/ml (12). The second factors is rice plant old while to inocu- late (S) namely at two week after transplanting (S1), four week after transplanting (S2), six week after transplanting (S3), and eight week after transplanting (S4). Paragraf: The research of effect of the ratio of N. P. K ele- ment and the number of pruning leaves on yield of Okra (Abelmoschus esculantus) has been carried out in Mei 22 until July 25, 1996 at Kertosari village, Secang district, Magelang regency, Central Java. The soil type is latosol with 6,5 pH and the altitude 362 metres above the sea level. The research used faktorial (3x3) with randomized completly block design (RCBD), two factors and three replications. The first factor is the ratio of N, P, K element (P), consist of three levels are the ratio N, P, K element 1 1 2 (P1), 1:2:1 (P2), 2: 1: 1 (P3). The second factor is the number of pruning leaves (D), consist of three levels is Do (no pruning), D1 (the pruning 4 leaves) and D2 (the pruning 8 leaves). The result of research showed that: The ratio of N. P. K element 1: 2: 1 increases flower initiation, number of flowers per plant, number of fruits per plant, weight of fruit per plant, number of leaves per plant and dry weight of straw, but does not increase to height of plant and fresh weight of straw. The number of pruning 4 leaves increases flower initiation, number of flowers per plant, The number of fruits per plant, weight of fruit per plant, number of leaves per plant and dry weight of straw but does not increase to height of plant and fresh weight of straw.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH PERBANDINGAN UNSUR N, P, K, DAN JUMLAH PEMANGKASAN DAUN TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN OKRA ( Abelmoschus esculantus )

Paragraf: The research on the effect of fertilizing the mother trees on tea cuttings growth (Camellia sinensis L.) had been carried out from February 20 until June 12, 1992. The location of the research was in Pagilaran tea Company. Batang Regency. Central Java Province, with the elevation of about 1000 metres above sea level. The soil type is Andosol, with the acidity (pH) 5,0 The design used was experimental design based of Randomized Complete Design (RCD) consisted of four treatments were tested with Duncan's Test at 5% level. The observation. was done on the factor: P0: without fertilizer (control) P1: using 2% concentration of ZA fertilizer P2: using 0,2% concentration of Bayfolan fertilizer P3: using 0,5% concentration of ZnS04, fertilizer The result of this research showed that 2% concentration of ZA fertilizer affect very significantly to the number of leaves, length of shoots, length of roots, fresh weight of shoots and dry weight of shoots, significantly affect the fresh weight of roots, percentage of alive cuttings, no significantly effect to the number of roots and dry weight of roots. The Bayfolan fertilizer affect significantly to the number of leaves, length of shoots, percentage of alive cuttings and length of roots, no significant effect on the number of roots, fresh weight of shoots and dry weight of roots. The ZnSO4, fertilizer affect very significantly to the number of leaves, fregh weight of roots and dry weight of roots, signi- ficantly affect the percentage of alive cuttings, number of roots, the length of shoots and length of roots, no significant effect to the fresh weight of shoots and dry weight of shoots. The best fertilizer to affect the growth of tea cuttinge (Camellia sinensis L.) is ZnSO4 (Zink Sulfate).
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH PEMUPUKAN POHON INDUK TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN TURUS TEH ( Camellia sinensis L. )

Paragraf: SUMMARY Gibberellin is a phytohormone, it's chemical structure is characterised by a gibban and has has a streng biological effect to the stimulation of growth. An experiment about the effect of gibberellin treat- ment on some varieties of cowpea (Vigna unguiculata (L.) Walp.) was conducted at Potrobangsan, Magelang from No vember 1991 until February 1992. The experiment aimed to determine the effect of gibberellin to the yield of some varieties of cowpea. A field experiment using a factorial experimental pattern consisting of 2 factor arranged in Randomized Com- plete Block Design with 3 replications was employed. The first factor is gibberellin concentration, consisting of (G1) 0 ppm, (G2) 10 ppm, (G3) 30 ppm, (G4) 50 ppm. The se- cond factor is varieties of cowpea, consisting of (E1) KT- 2 variety, (E2) lokal kebumen variety, (E3) lokal bantul variety. Gibberellin had been applied at 15, 30, 45 days after planting. The result obtained showed that addition of 50 ppm gibberellin could increase the growth and development of cowpea that could be obtain from the increasing of the height of plant, the fresh weight of crown, the dry weight of crown and shortened the flowering time.
Judul: SKRIPSI PEMBERIAN KONSENTRASI GIBBERELLIN ( GA-3 ) TERHADAP HASIL BEBERAPA VARIETAS KACANG TUNGGAK ( Vigna ungiculata ( L. ) Walp. )

Paragraf: The experiment on tolerance of Bradyrhizobium japonicum to residue of pesticide uses with the preventive and curative level doses for soybean plant was purposed to find out the effect residue of pesticide uses for bacteria of Bradyrhizobium japonicum with the preventive and cura tive level doses. Tolerance of Bradyrhizobium japonicum to residue of insecticide Larvin on the preventive and curative doses not the effect of nitrogen fixation.
Judul: SKRIPSI TOLERANSI Bradyrhizobium japonicum TERHADAP RESIDU  PEMAKAIAN PESTISIDA DENGAN TINGKAT DOSIS PREVENTIF DAN KURATIF PADA TANAMAN KEDELAI ( Glycine max L. MERR )

Paragraf: SUMMARY The purpose of this experiment is to know the effect of weeding time and urea dose on the yield of cauli flo- wer (Brassica oleracea subvar cauliflora DC.). This experiment was conducted at latonol soil type, on altitude of 840 m above sea level and pH 6,0. S3 weeding on 42 and 56 days after planting. Weeding time increased yield 264% 1399%. The bi- ghest yield was obtained by treatment 8,D2 (weeding time on 14 and 28 days after planting and urea dose 10 g per plant) (9,6982 ton/ha).
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH SAAT PENYIANGAN DAN DOSIS UREA TERHADAP HASIL KUBIS BUNGA ( Brassica oleracea subvar cauliflora DC. )

Paragraf: Dalam kenytaannya manusia hidup itu tidak dapat dipisahkan dari keberadaan sebuah organisasi. Jika mereka itu tidak menghabiskan sebagian besar waktu mereka sebagai anggota organisasi (pekerjaan, sekolah, sosial, warga negara dan sebagainya), maka mereka dIpengaruhi oleh organisasi, sebagai nasabah, pasien, pelanggan atau warga negara. Orang mendirikan sebuah organisasi itu karena mempunyai anggapan bahwa beberapa tujuan tertentu hanya dapat dicapai melalui tindakan yang harus dilakukan dengan persetujuan bersama. Jadi, apakah tujuan itu laba, pemberian pendidikan, agama atau tujuan yang lain, namun ciri organisasi itu tetap sama, perilakunya terarah pada tujuan (goal-directed behavior). Artinya organisasi itu mengejar tujuan dan sasaran yang dapat dicapai secara lebih efisien dan lebih efektif dengan tindakan dilakukan secara bersama-sama. Yang Oleh karena itu bukan merupakan hal yang berlebihan jika suatu organisasi dituntut untuk selalu sesuat dapat mewujudkan tujuan dan sasaran organisasi sesuai dengan tujuan awalnya. Sedangkan untuk menunjang terwujudnya tujuan organisasi secara optimal, haruslah didukung oleh aspek kerja pegawai yang efektif yang merupakan aset atau modal utama dari organisasi itu. Demikian pula dengan organisasi Sekwilda Tingkat II Kabupaten Kebumen yang merupakan organisasi unsur staf yang berfungsi membantu Kepala Daerah dalam menyelenggarakan pemerintahan. Dimana untuk mewujudkan fungsi Sekwilda tersebut dituntut adanya efektifitas kerja pegawai. Adapun guna mendukung terciptanya efektivitas Kerja pegawai terdapat beberapa faktor yang tidak dapat dilepaskan pengawasan. dari padanya, yaitu faktor motivasi dan pengawasan. 1. Hipotesa Mayor. Motivasi dan Pengawasan mempunyai pengaruh yang positif terhadap efektifitas kerja pegawai. 2. Hipotesa Minor. -Motivasi mempunyai pengaruh positif terhadap etektifitas kerja pegawai. -Pengawasan mempunyai pengaruh positif terhadap efektifitas kerja pegawai. Dalam penelitian ini sebagai obyek penelitiannya adalah para pegawai Kantor Sekretariat Wilayah Daerah (Sekwilda) Tingkat II Kabupaten Kebumen. Sebagai sampelnya diambil 45 responden, pengumpulan datanya diperoleh dengan menggunakan teknik observasi, wawancara, kuesioner dan dokumentasi. Sumber data primer dan didukung sumber data sekunder, Sedang analisa datanya digunakan analisa data kuantitatif dan kualitatif. Adapun untuk menguji hipotesa digunakan teknik korelasi product moment, korelasi partial, korelasi ganda/majemuk dan koefisien determinasi, hasil analisanya adalah: 1. Terdapat korelasi yang sangat signifikan antara x1 (motivasi) dengan Y (efektifitas kerja pegawai). hal ini terbukti dengan perbandingan antara rx1у yang lebih besar daripada r tabel 99% atau (0,578) > (0,430). 2. Terdapat korelasi yang signifikan antara x2y (pengawasan) dengan Y (efektifitas kerja pegawai), hal ini terbukti dengan perbandingan antara rx2y yang lebih besar daripada r-tabel 99% atau (0,585 > (0,430). 3. Terdapat hubungan yang signifikan antara x1 (motivasi) dengan x2 (pengawasan), hal ini terbukti dengan perbandingan antara hal rx1x2 yang tebih besar daripada r-tabel 99% atau (0,620) > (0,430). 4. Hubungan antara x1 (motivasi) dengan Y (efektifitas kerja pegawai) dikontrol variabel x1 (pengawasan) adalah murni. Hal ini dibuktikan dengan perbandingan antara F-test yang lebih besar daripada F-tabel 1% atau (5,51> (429). 5. Hubungan antara x2 (pengawasan) dengan Y (efektifitas kerja pegawas) dikontrol variabel x1 (motivasi) adalah marni. Hal ini dibuktikan dengan perbandingan antara F-test yang lebih besar dari- pada F-tabel 1% atau (5,89 > (429). 6. Hubungan antara x1 (motivasi) dan x2 (komunikasi secara pegawai) bersama-sama dengan Y (efektifitas pegawai) adalah sangat signifikan. Hal ini dibuktikan dengan perbandingan antara F-test yang lebih besar daripada F-tabel 1% (31,68) > (4.82). 7. Prosentase pengaruh X1 (pengawasan) terhadap X2 (motivasi) terhadap Y (efektifitas kerja pegawai) adalah 42%. Hal ini berarti bahwa 58% lainnya adalah merupakan faktor pengaruh efektifitas kerja pegawai di luar penelitian ini. Dari hasil pengujian hipotesa di atas dapat disimpulkan bahwa hubungan antara motivasi dan pengawasan dengan efektifitas kerja pegawai Kantor Sekwilda Tingkat II Kabupaten Kebumen mempunyai arah yang positif.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH MOTIVASI DAN PENGAWASAN TERHADAP EFEKTIFITAS KERJA PEGAWAI SEKERTARIAT WILAYAH DAERAH TINGKAT II KEBUMEN

Paragraf: Untuk mewujudkan cita-cita serta tujuan bangsa, kita wujudkan dalam suatu bentuk organisasi, sebab organisasi adalah sebagai sadah suatu kerja yang terikat secara formal dalam hirarkhi wewenang dan tanggung jawab maupun proses kerjasama antar manusia. Berhasilnya suatu organisasi tidak saja tergantung pada pimpinan tetapi ditunjang juga oleh bawahan serta kecakapan, pengetahuan dan ketrampilan dari atanan dan bawahan. Tujuan penelitian ini adalah untuk mengetahui pengaruh Pendidikan dan Latihan serta Kepemimpinan terhadap Efektivitas Organisasi. 1. Hipotess Hayor Pendidikan dan latihan pegawai secara bersama-sama mempengruhi Efektivitas Organisasi. 2. Hipotesa Minor -Pendidikan dan latihan mempunyai pengaruh terhadap efektivitas organisasi. -Kepemimpinan mempunyai pengaruh terhadap efektivitas organisasi Kedua hipotesa tersebut setelah diuji menunjukkan signifikan atau mempunyai pengaruh. Untuk keperluan penelitian ini yang menjadi obyek penelitian adalah kantor Biro Keuangan Sekretariat Daerah Propinsi Jawa Tengah. Sedangkan yang menjadi responden adalah pegawainya, yang ada di kantor tersebut. Sedangkan type penelitian adalah type penelitian penjelasan. Sumber datanya adalah sumber data primer dan sumber data sekunder. Tekhnik pengambilan sampelnya adalah menggunakan tekhnik Stratified Random Sampling dan cara pengambilan undian. Untuk menganalisa data digunakan analisa kwantitatif dan analisa kwalitatif dan untuk menguji hipotesa digunakan Tekhnik Korelani Product Moment, Korelasi Partial, Korelasi Gands/Majemuk dan Tekhnik Koefisien Determinasi. Pengujian berikut: hipotesa diperoleh hamil sebagai 1. Pengaruh Pendidikan dan Latihan serta Kepemimpinan terhadap Efektivitas Organisasi diuji dengan menggunakan rumus korelasi dikonsultasikan dengan r-tabel teoritis dengan db 82, 402 38, hasilnya 0.413. Hamil -tabel ini dibandingkan dengan Fxly yaitu (0,548 0,413) Karena r-hitung lebih besar dari r-tabel berarti ada korelasi signifikan antara kedua variabel. 2. Pengaruh kepemimpinan terhadap efektivitas organisasi diuji dengan menggunakan rumus kolerasi product moment menunjukkan hasil 0,611. Setelah dibandingkan dengan r-tabel ternyata (0,611 > 0,413). Dengan demikian ada kolerasi signifikan antara kedua variabel. 3. Pengaruh pendidikan dan Latihan serta kepemimpinan secara bersama-sama terhadap efektivitas Organisasi. Untuk menganalisa data digunakan analisa kwantitatif dan analisa kwalitatif dan untuk menguji hipotesa digunakan Tekhnik Korelani Product Moment, Korelasi Partial, Korelasi Gands/Majemuk dan Tekhnik Koefisien Determinasi. Pengujian berikut: hipotesa diperoleh hasil sebagai 1. Hamil -tabel ini dibandingkan dengan Fxly yaitu (0,548 0,413) Karena r-hitung lebih besar dari r-tabel berarti ada korelasi signifikan antara kedua variabel. 2. Dengan demikian ada kolerasi signifikan antara kedua variabel. 3. Pengaruh pendidikan dan Latihan serta kepemimpinan secara bersama-sama terhadap efektivitas Organisasi. a. Hubungan antara kepemimpinan dan pendidikan dan latihan diuji dengan menggunakan korelasi product moment menunjukkun honil 0,717. Kemudian di konsultasikan dengan r-tabel (0,717 >0,413). Karena z-tabel lebih kecil dengan r- hitung berarti hubungan kedua variabel adalah signifikan. b. Mencari hubungan antara pendidikan dan latihan dengan efektivitas organisasi dengan rumus korelasi pastial, menujukkan hasil 0,119. Untuk menguji dengan rumus F test yang hasilnya menunjukkan 0,531. Hasil ini kemudian dikonsultasikan dengan F tabel, ternyata F tabel (0,531 > 4,38). Hal ini berarti hubungan variabel yang diuji palsu. c. Kemudian diuji signifikannya dengan rumus F test. Hasil ini dikonsultasikan dengan F tabel pada taraf 1x hasilnya 50,88. Selanjutnya dikonsultasikan dengan F tabel (50,88 > 4,38). Dengan demikian dapat dikatakan pendidikan dan latihan serta kepemimpinan mempunyai pengaruh terhadap efektivitas organisasi e. Paragraf: The research title is balance and time of nitrogen and phosphor fertilizer dose application on Chinese Cabbage (Brassica pekinensis) has done begin May 19 th until August 19 th 1990 at Sutopati village, Kajoran district, Magelang regent. The soil type is Andosol, an altitude of 1100 m and pH 6,5. The purpose of the research is to know balance and time of nitrogen and phosphor fertilizer dose application on Chinese Cabbage (Brassica pekinensis). The design research which used is factorial experiment 3 x 3 by 4 replications arranged in Randomized Complate Block Design (RCBD). Factor I balance nitrogen (urea) and phosphor (TSP) fertilizer dose. I1 = N 87.5 kg per ha fertilizer dose and P 192.5 kg per ha fertilizer. I2 = N 175 kg per ha fertilizer dose and P 105 kg per ha fertilizer. 13 = N 227.5 kg per ha fertilizer dose and P52.5 kg per ha fertilizer. Factor II: time of nitrogen (urea) and phosphor (TSP) fertilizer dose. S1 = 1 week after had planted in the field. S2 = 2 weeks after had planted in the field. S3 = 3weeks after had planted in the field. The result of research showed that balance and time of nitrogen and phosphor fertilizer dose is non significant different for gross weight per plant, net (crop) weight per plant, crop diameter, total leaves per crop, maximum leaves length, maximum leaves wide and crop dry weight.
Judul: SKRIPSI IMBANGAN SERTA SAAT PEMBERIAN DOSIS PUPUK N DAN P TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN PETSAI (Brassica pekinensis)

Paragraf: A research to examine legin application and its dose to the root nodulation and pea-nut (Arachis hypogaea L.) yield Kelinci variety was carried out at green house Potrobangsan Village, North of Magelang District and alti- tude of 350 meters above sea level, at latosol soil and 6,5 pH. The research was from January until April 1996. The method used is factorial experiment with Randomized Completely Design, with three replications. The first factors is legin application method there are non sticker of inoculant, water sticker of inoculant and tapioka sticker of inoculant. The second factors legin dose there are 4 g. 8 g and 12 g/kg seeds. The finding of the experiment lead to conclution as follows: 1. Legin application with tapioka sticker inoculant gives increase number of effective nodules number of ineffec- tive nodules, number of filled pods, weight of filled pods, weight of fresh of effective nodules, N content of effective nodules and weight of 100 dry seeds. 2. The increase of dose of legin application can increase number of effective nodules, fresh weight of filled pods and weight of 100 dry seeds. 3. No interaction between legin application method and legindose. 4. Legin application with tapioka sticker and 8 g/kg seeds can increase number of effective nodules, number of ineffective nodules, number of filled pods, fresh weight of filled pods, fresh weight of effective nodules, N content of effevtive nodules and weight of 100 dry seeds.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH CARA PEMBERIAN DAN DOSIS LEGIN TERHADAP PEMBENTUKAN BINTIL AKAR HASIL TANAMAN KACANG TANAH (Arachis hypogaea L.)

Paragraf: The aim of the experiment is study the influence of Super TW organic fertilizer dose to the growth and yield of cauli- flower (Brassica oleracea L.) subvar. cauliflora DC. on several kinds of soil as growth media. The research method uses (4x3) factorial experiment with randomized complete block design consist of three replications. Treatment analysed by analysis of variance at 5% level then tested by HSD at 5% level if significant and the orthogonal polinomial. First factor is Super TW organic fertilizer dose they are 0.15; 0.3; 0,6 kg/plant. Second factor is kinds of soil they are Latosol, Regosol and Grumusol. The result of research shows that Super TW organic ferti- lizer dose gives a very significant effect for all observed parameters. There was interaction between Super TW organic fertilizer dosage and kinds of soil for flowering age, flower diameter and the harvest age. Super TW organic fertilizer 0.45 kg/plant gives highest yield for number of leaves, flower diameter and flower weight. Dose at 0.3 kg/plant causes the fastest of flowering age and harvest age. The regosol soil causes the fastest of flowering age and the highest yield for flower diameter. In this research, the highest yield is obtained by D2T2, it is 171.67 g or equivalent to 19.07 ton/ha and the lowest is obtained by DoT2, it is 100.25 g or equivalent to 11.14 ton/ha.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS PUPUK ORGANIK SUPER TW PADA BEBERAPA JENIS TANAH TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN DAN HASIL TANAMAN KOBIS BUNGA ( Brassica oleracea L. ) subvar. Cauliflora DC.

Paragraf: The research about influence Atonik and Rootone F on the growth vanilla cutting was carried out at Banjarnegoro village, Mertoyudan District, Magelang City, Province Cen- tral Java January untul April 1992. The kindi of soil os latosol, the soil pH is 6 with altitude of 360 meter sea level. The research it was arranget in factorial methode used RCBD, which consisted of two treatment factors with three replication, fisrt factor, Atonik concentration which of consisted were : 0; 0,5 and 1 cc/litre water. And second factor Rootone F dosage which consisted were: 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20 mg/cutting The result of the experiment analysis are: 1. Atonik is very significant on shoot lenght, of fresh weight of shoot, of dry weight of shoot and of leaves number. But it affected on significant to percentage of growth cutting, of number of main roots, of lenght of Bain rocte, of fresh weight of roots and of dry weight of roots. 2. Rootone F give influence very significant on shoot lenght of fresh weight of shoot, of dry weight of shoot and leaves number. But it affected on significant to percen tage of growth cutting, of number of main roots, of lenght of main roots, of fresh weight of roots and of dry weight of roots. 3. The treatment was interaction Atonik and Bootone F to the lenght of shoot with isn't interaction percentage of growth cutting, the weight of shoot fresh, the dry weight of shoot, the number of leaves, the number of main roots, the length of roots, the fresh weight of roots and thedry weight of roots. 4. The treatment Atonik with concentration 0,5 cc/litre water which to combine Rootone Fwith dosage 15 mg/cutting (A1R3) showed the best, moderate Atonik with concentration O cc/litre water (as controle) and Rootone F with dosage 0 mg/cutting (A0R0) showed low of yeld.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH ANATONIK DAN ROOTONE F TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN STEK PANILI (Vanilla planifolia andrews)

Paragraf: An experiment about the effect of bud number on side grafting on growth of some cacao (Theobroma cacao, L) clones was conducted from March 1997 to June 1997 in Muncang village, Bodeh district of Pemalang Regency. The elevation is ± 15 meters above sea level with brown alluvial soil and pH 5,1- 6,0. This experiment is arranged factorially (2 x 4) with completely randomized design with three replications. The firts factor is two buds and three buds. The second factor is four clones cacao namely RCC 70, RCC 71 RCC 72, and RCC 73. The result of this experiment shows that increasing number of buds does not increase percent of alive grafting but decreases diameter of shoot. Clones influence number of shoot, diameter of shoot, number of leaves and width of leaves. The number of buds used on side grafting has influenced length of shoot and number of buds. Number and position of buds on entrest influence the growth of shoot.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH JUMLAH MATA TUNAS SAMBUNG SAMPING TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN BEBERAPA KLON KAKAO (Theobroma cacao, L)

Paragraf: The purpose of this experiment is to know the ef fect of the dept urea briket fertilizer foward the re sult of the cauli flower (Brassica oleraceae L) var. Cauli flower DS. The experiment has been carried out in Jetak, Bandongan, Magelang Regency. It has been done from Oktober to November 1993, with Latosol soil type, pH 5,5 and atlitude of 431 meters above sea le- vel. Methodology of this experiment is the Randomized Complete Block Design (RCBD), this consists of 5 treatment and 5 time. And the treatment are : K1: The dept of urea briket 2 cm from the surface of land K2: The dept of urea briket 4 cm from the surface of land K3 The dept of urea briket 6 cm from the surface of land K4: The dept of urea briket 8 cm from the surface of land K5: The dept of urea briket 10 cm from the surface of land The result of this experiment: 1. The treatment of the dept urea briket give a real influence toward the age flowering, the weight curd per plant, the diameter of curd, the fresh of weight of straw and the harvest index. The number of the leaves, the height of the plant, the age of harvesting and the dry weight of straw do not a re al influence. 2. The result of the highest weight of clean curd per plant achieved at the treatment Kz (the dept 6 cm) is as big as 354,4 gram/plant and the lowest at the treatment K5 (the dept 10 cm) is as big as 231,8 gram/plant.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH KEDALAMAN PEMBENAMAN PUPUK UREA BRIKET TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN KOBIS BUNGA ( Brassica Oleraceae L. Var. Cauli Flower D.S )

Paragraf: The experiment of effect of dose of NPK and kinds of media on yield of pakchoi (Brassica chinensis L.), had been carried since out July 1999 until October 1999 at Gegunung village, Bandongan sub district, Magelang Regency. The type of soil is latosol with pH 6,0 and altitude 500 meters. The method of experiment is factorial (4x4) on completely randomized design, with five replications. The first factor is composition between soil and dung fertilizer (2:1). The dung fertilizer are chiken manure, goat manure and cow manure. The second factors is NPK dose 0; 0,23; 0,30; dan 0,38 gram/polybag. The result of the experiment shows that kindas of media increase the height of plant, the number of leaves per plant, the fresh weight of root and the fresh weight of straw. The dose of NPK increase the height of plant, the number of leaves per plant, the longest leaf, the leaves area of longest leaf, the weight of longest leaf and fresh weight of straw. Two factors in this experiment do not increase of all parameters.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS NPK DAN MACAM MEDIA TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN PAKCHOI (Brassica chinensis, L.)

Paragraf: A research of the effect of soaking interval and concentration of coconut water on Vanilla growth (Vanilla planifolia, Andrwes), had been carried out since 5th October 2003 until 3rd January 2004 at Gilingsari Village, Temanggung District, Temanggung Regency. The soil is latosol, with pH 6,5. The altitude is 530 meters. The method of experiment is factorial (3 x 3) with randomised completely block design, consist of three replications. The first factor is of soaking interval of coconut water 0, 12, and 24 hours. The second is concentration in 0, 50 and 100%. The result of research shows that the soaking interval coconut water 11.48-13.30 hour may increase on length of shoots and fresh weight of shoots. Concentration water coconut 52-57% may increase on length of shoots, fresh weight of shoots, dry weight of shoots, fresh weight of roots and dry weight of roots. The longer the soaking interval on concentration coconut of water may increase on length of shoots with soaking interval 13 hour 30 minute on concentration 54,1% and too fresh weight of shoots on soaking interval 11 hour 48 minute with concentration 55,1%.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH LAMA PERENDAMAN DAN KONSENTRASI AIR KELAPA TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN STEK PANILI (Vanilla planifolia, Andrews)

Paragraf: The research of the influence of kind of soil and Guano Phosphat fertilizer dose on yield of long bean (Vigna sinensis Savi L.) had been conducted from September 10th 1997 until December 10th 1997, at Klopo village, Tegalrejo District, Magelang Regency, Central Java Province. The altitude is 500 metres. This research used factorial (2x4) experiment with randomized completely design, consist of three repli- cations. Factor I: kind of soil (T), that is latosol and gambut. Factor II: Guano Phosphat fertilizer dose that is 0, 150, 225 and 300 kg/ha. The result of this reseach shows that: 1. The higher Guano Phosphat fertilizer dose will fasten flowering and age of harvesting, increase number of pods, weight of pods, length of pods, fresh weight of straw and dry weight of straw. 2. On latosol soil age of flowering and age of harvesting are faster and number of pods, weight of pods, length of pods, fresh weight of straw and dry weight of straw are higher than on gambut soil. 3. The combination of treatment of latosol soil and Guano Phosphat fertilizer dose of 225 kg/ha results In number of pods and weight of pods the highest.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH JENIS TANAH DAN DOSIS PUPUK GUANO PHOSPAT PADA HASIL TANAMAN KACANG PANJANG SUPER

Paragraf: A research about the effect of potato, tomato, and papaya extract on the growth of melon buds on in vitro propagation, has been carried out from 1 April 2001 until 25 September 2001. The experiment is located at Balai Benih Induk Hortikultura, Salaman, Magelang, Central Java, with an altitude of 296 meters, on a latosol soil, pH of 6, with an average of presipitation 2500-3000 mm/year. The research uses factorial (3x3) experiment with randomized completely design consist of three replications. The first factor is kind of extract (potato, tomato, and papaya). The second factor is the increasing concentration of extract (5%, 10% and 15%). The results of experiment show that papaya extract has the highest in buds mutiplication. Potatoe extract has the highest in planlets lenght, roots lenght, number of leaves, and fresh weight of planlets. Increasing of extract concentration causes a constant decrease of planlets lenght and roots lenght. But it gives different increase in fresh weight and dry weight of planlets. The increase of extract concentration on each extract only gives different respon in number of buds, planlets lenght, and roots lenght.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH EKSTRAK UMBI KENTANG, EKSTRAK BUAH TOMAT, DAN EKSTRAK BUAH PEPAYA TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN PUCUK TANAMAN MELON (Cucumis melo L.) MELALUI KULTUR JARINGAN

Paragraf: The research about the effect of Grand-K ferti- lizer dose and the number of fruits on yield of water melon (Citrullus vulgaris, Scard) had been done since July 10th to October 17th 2000 at Bojong village Mungkid District, Magelang Regency, Central Java. The kind of soil is regosol and the altitude is 350 meters. The research uses experiment in randomized complete block design, factorial (4 x 2) with three replications. The first factor is Grand-K fertilizer dose (kg/block): 0; 0,168; 0,336 and 0,504. The second factors the number of fruit, one and two fruits per plant. The result of the research showes that Grand-K fertilizer dose does not affect the female flower iniciation, the pollinations time and harvest age, but affects the weight per fruit, the fruits weight per plant and fruit diameters. The number of fruit not effect the female flowers iniciation, the pollination time and harvest age, but affects the weight per fruit, the fruits weight per plant and fruit diameters. The highest weight of fruit per plant has been achived on treatmen combination Grand-K fertilizer 166,67 kg/ha and two fruits per plant. Increasing Grand-K dose at any number of fruits does not effect all parameters observed.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS PUPUK GRAND-K DAN JUMLAH BUAH TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN SEMANGKA ( Citrullus vulgaris, Schard) VARITAS TOP QUALITY

Paragraf: The experiment of the effect of nitrogen fertilizer dose and time of tipping on patchauly yield, had been car- ried out at Semen village, Windusari district, Magelang. The soil type is lotosol with pH 6,5 and altitude 390 m above sea level. The experiment uses Randomized Complete Block Design (RCBD), consisted of two factors and three replication. The fist factor is nitrogen application withhout fertili- zer supply until dose 120 kg/ha, with range 40 kg/ha. Second factor is time of tipping 4,5 month old, begining at 1,5 month, with rage 1,5 month, The rise of nitrogen supply can increase all value of observated parameters. The rise of age of tipping can in- crease fresh weight of prunning, weight of air dried prun- ning and patchauly oil content, but the of rise age of tipping can decrease number of branch, fresh weight of harvest and weight of dry harvest. The rise of age of tipping and nitrogen fertilizer can increase all value of parameters observed.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS PUPUK UREA DAN SAAT PEMANGKASAN TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN NILAM ( Pogostemon cablin Benth )

Paragraf: The research about the effect of the kind of coconuts water and water concentration to the yield of garlic Lumbu Putih variety (Allium sativum L), had been caried out from April 118t to July 115t, 1992 at Pandeyan village, Mertoyudan Subdistrick, Magelang, Central Java. The altitude of 310 meter above sea level, pH 5,57 and the kind of soil is Latosol. Its has purpose to know the effect of coconuts water to the yield of garlic. The reseach used the Completely Randomized Design (CRD) it was arranged in factorial, Which cosisted of two tretments with three replications. The treatments were kind of coconuts water (green coconuts water and red coconuts water) and concentration of coconuts water (25, 50, 75 and 100%). The yield of the research showed that coconuts water increased the yield of garlic. The treatment of the kind of coconuts water gives no significant different effect to all of the parameters absorved, consisted of percentage of germination, leaves number, the leaf area, plant height, fresh weight of bulb per plant, dry weight of bulb per plant, fresh weight of straw, dry weight of straw, the bulb diametre and corm number per plant. Con- centration of coconuts water gives highly significant different effect to corm number per bulb, and significant different effect to height plant, fresh weight of straw,
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH MACAM DAN KONSENTRASI AIR KELAPA TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN BAWANG PUTIH VARIESTA LUMBU PUTIH ( Allium Sativum L. )

Paragraf: The experiment to know the effect of prunning age and dose of SP-36 fertilizer on yield of cucumber (Cucumis sativus L.) had been carried out since 10 March until 9 June 1997 at Girikulon village, Secang distric, Magelang regency. The soil type is lathosol with pH 6,5 and altitude 380 me- ters above sea level. The method used is factorial experiment (3x3) with ran- domized complete block design, consisted of three replica- tions. The first factor is prunning age, consisted of three levels: 1 week, 2 weeks and 3 weeks prunning age. Second factor is SP-36 fertilizer dose, consisted of three levels : 0, 100 dan 200 kg/ha SP-36. The result of the experiment showed that : 1. Later age of prunning can fasten age of flowering, in- crease number of leaves per plant, lenght of fruits and volume of fruits, but can not influence ratio of produc- tion.. 2. The rise of SP-36 fertilizer dose can increase number of leaves per plant, lenght of fruits and volume of fruits, but can not influence for age of flowering and ratio of production. 3. The size of longer and bigger cucumber which gained at the first of harvest.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH SAAT PEMANGKASAN PUCUK DAN DOSIS PUPUK SP-36 TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN MENTIMUN ( Cucumis sativus L. )

Paragraf: A research entitled the influence of the weight of seeds and planting system to the production of maize Arjuna variety, had been done at Dampit village, Merto yudan in the Magelang regent on Latosol soil and at an altitude of 340 meters. The research started on 13 Octo- ber 1988 to 12 January 1989. The purpose of the research was to know abouth the effect of the weight of seeds and planting system to the production of maize Arjuna varie- ty. The research method was factorial 2 X 3 with arranged in Randomized Comletely Block Design (RCBD) consisted of 2 factor and 4 replications. The first factor was weight of grains: 3234 g; 2729 g 21 - 23 g per 100 grains. The second factor was the planting system: single row (75 cm X 30 cm) and rectangular (50 cm X 50 cm). The parameters observed were plant height at harvest, the lenght of ear at harvest, the fresh weight of ear at harvest, the dry weight of ear, the weight of dry grains per plot, the weight of 1000 grains and the fresh weight of straw at harvest. The result of the research showed that the weight of grains and planting system gave no real influence to the production of maize Arjuna variety, except in the weight of fresh straw at harvest. But the result of the research showed that the use of big and heavy grains inclined better than little light grains. From the result of the research, the highest yield of dry grainsper plot was obtained from the combination treatment BT 5,2625 kg, and the lowest B3T1= 4,6075 kg.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH BERAT BENIH DAN TATA TANAM TERHADAP PRODUKSI JAGUNG (Zea Mays L.) VARIESTA ARJUNA

Paragraf: The research about the effect of dose of azolla compost and volume of water feeding on the yield of celery (Apium graveolens, L.), had been carried out since May, 2000 untill August, 2000 at the green house of the departement of Agriculture, University of Tidar Magelang, the altitude is 360 meters. The method is factorial experiment (3x3) on completely randomized design, consist of three replications with analysis of variance and orthogonal polinomial. The first factor is dose of azolla compost, 20; 40 dan 60 g/polybag. The second factor is volume of water feeding, 2; 1⁄2 and I of field capasity. The result of the research shows that giving azolla compost with dose 20 g/polybag untill 45 g/polybag is able to increase plant height, leaves stalk number, nett weight of plant, gross weight of plant and dry weight of plant. Water feeding with volume 1⁄2 field capasity untill 0,8 of field capasity is able to increase at leaves stalk number, nett weight of plant, gross weight of plant and dry weight of plant. Adding azolla compost till 40 g/polybag on volume of water feeding 0,84 of field capasity is able to increase nett weight and gross weight of plant. The research shows that the best yield is obtained at using 45 g/polybag azolla compost and volume of water feeding 0,8 of field capasity.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS KOMPOS AZOLLA DAN VOLUME PEMBERIAN AIR TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN SELEDRI (Apium graveolens L. )

Paragraf: The obyective of this experiment is know the influence of rate and time application of dolomite on tobacco seedling growth of Kedu kind of Gober va- riety. This experiment was carried out at Secang villa- ge, Secang district, Magelang regency, from June, 23 until August, 6, 1987. The soil type is Latosol, the altitude is 440 m above sea level. The design used was Randomized Complete Block design (RCBD), arranged in factorial, with 2 factor treatment and was replicated three times. The rate of application used were 4 level, namely: D0 : Without dolomite D1 : 10 gram per m D2 : 20 gram per m D3 : 30 gram per m 2 The time of application consist of 3 level, namely: W0: Without dolomite W1 : 15 days before seed was spreaded W2 : 7 days before seed was spreaded W3 : together with seed was spreaded 3 The observation include the seedling height, number of leaf, leaf width, leaf length, circle of stem, root length, root.number, seedling fresh weight and seedling dry weight. The all of the levels treatment non significant by all observation. The test of compared with control treatment (DoWo) result is turned out, that various traetment of sig- nificant on seedling height, leaf length and seedling dry weight.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS DAN WAKTU PEMBERIAN DOLOMIT TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN BIBIT TEMBAKAU  ( Nicotiana Tabacum, L ) KEDU VARIETAS GOBER

Paragraf: The research of effect of dose of Harmony P1 on growth and yield of bitter gourd varieties (Momordica charantia, L.) had been carried out since August 8th until Nopember 2th 1999 at Mungkid Village, Mungkid District, Magelang Regency, Central of Java. The soil type is regosol with pH 6,5 and the altitude is 350 meters. The method uses factorial Split Plot experiment (2 x 4) in randomized completely block design with three replications. The first factor as main plot is dose of Harmony P1 0, 200, 400 and 600 cc/plant. The second factor is sub plot Maya 03 and Isabel 196 variety. The result of the experiment shows that increasing of dose of Harmony P1 may accelerate age of flowering, increase weight of fruits, volume of fruits and fresh weight of straw. The number of fruits per plant and dry weight of straw responded the same. Kind of variety gives regular responses on all of parameters. Variety of Maya 03 however showed weight of fruits better, that is 184,9 g compare to of variety Isabel 196, that is 169,69 g. The increase of dose of Harmony P1 on variety have the same responses.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH PERBANDINGAN DOSIS HARMONY P1 PADA BEBERAPA VARIETAS TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN PARE (Momordica charantia, L. )

Paragraf: A research to study the effect of planting distance and dose of organic fertilizer on yield of Aster (Aster chinensis) was done in Bandungan, Ambarawa, Central Java from October 20, to Desember 30, 1997. The altitude is 850 m and the type of soil is Latosol. The reseach uses factorial (3X4) experiment with random- ized complete blok design and three replications. The first factor is planting distance are 15X17, 15X15 and 15X13 cm2. The second factor is dose of organic fertilizer are 0, 10, 20, and 30 ton/ha. The result shows that increasing planting distance can increase fresh weight of straw. Increaing organic fertilizer may enhance age of harvesting, bunch diameter, dry weight and fresh weight of straw.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH JARAK TANAM DAN DOSIS PUPUK ORGANIK TERHADAP HASIL BUNGA POTONG ASTER (Aster chinensis)

Paragraf: An experiment concering the dose of gamma rays radiation and colchicine concentration on yield of shallot (Allium ascalonicum L) cultivare Bima had been conducted at Sudimoro Vallage, Srumbung District, Magelang Regency, Central Java Province, Kind of soil is regosol, the soil pH 5,7. The radiation of bulb had been done at BATAN Jakarta. The research uses (4x4) factorial experiment with randomized completly block design (RCBD), wich consist of three replications the first factor: Dosage of gamma rays radiation, consisted of 0, 4, 5 and 6 Gy. The second fac- tor: Colchicine concentration, consisted of 0, 0,0105, 0.0176 and 0.0282%. The result of this experiment: Increasing dose of gamma rays radiation can increases number of bulb, but decreases number of leaves, fresh weight of bulb, dry weight of bulb, fresh weight of straw, dry weight of straw, diameter of bulb. Increasing colchicine concentration can increases height of plant but decreases number of leaves, fresh weight of bulb, dry weight of bulb, diameter of bulb. Increasing concentration of colchicine at each dose of gamma rays canses different rate of fresh weight of bulb, dry weight of bulb and diameter of bulb. The higest yield found at treatment of gamma rays radiation dose 0 Gy and colchicine concentration 0%. The fresh weight of bulb is 46,69 g and dry weight of bulb is 31,82 g and diameter of bulb is 2,14 cm.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS SINAR GAMMA ( Co-60 ) DAN KONSENTRASI COLCHICINE TERHADAP HASIL BAWANG MERAH ( Allium ascalonicum L ) KULTIVAR BIMA

Paragraf: The experiment of the effect of method application and dosage TSP to yield soybean (Glycine max L. Merrill), was carried out at Kedungsari Village, sub District North Magelang, Magelang City, from 1.5 Agustus 1991 until 5 Novem- ber 1991. The soil type was latosol, the soil pH 6,7 with an altitude of 380 metres. The experiment design used was Split Plot Design (SPD) composed by Randomized Completely Block Design (RCBD), consisted of two factor by three replications. Factor 1. Method application TSP as main plot are three le- vel: Broadcost, in the row and side band. Factor 2. Dosage TSP as sub plot are four level : 0 ; 50 ; 100 and 150 kg/ha TSP The result of experiment showed that, the treatment dosage and method application ISP was significant to the number of fertile nodus and plant of height. Interaction method and dosage TSP very significant to the number of fertile nodus and weight of dry seed per plant. The heighest result from the number of fertile nodus 17,53 on composed treatment T2P3 and weight of dry seed per plant 3 heighest 7,76 on composed treatment T3P2.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS DAN CARA PEMBERIAN PUPUK TSP PADA TANAH LATOSOL TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN HASIL TANAMAN KEDELAI ( Glycine max L. merril )

Paragraf: Responses of some Soybean (Clycine max L. Merril) Variety Under Intensity of Tillage on The Ricefield. The experiment was conducted to detrimine the effect of va- rying Levels of tillage. And this experiment was carried out at Kramat village., North Magelang Subdistrict, Magelang Regency and Central Java Province. The altitude about 325 meters above sea level, the soil type is lato sol with pH about 6,6. The methode utilized was Factorial with Split Plot Design (SPD) based on Completly Randomized Design (CDR) variety as Main Plot an Intensity of Tillage as Sub Plot, the were replicated three times. The tillage treatment increase significant different to plant height, fresh plant weight, dry plant weight, number of pod per plant, number of filled pod per plant, number of seed per plant, number of flower bearing nodus per plant and seed weight per plant. The tilla- ge treatment also gave longer day to maturity. No tillage and tillage treatment gave the same of 100 seed weight and the same of harvest index. The higest of seed weight per plant was resulted by once of tillage treatment and the lowest of seed weight per plant was resulted by no tillage treatment.
Judul: SKRIPSI TANGGAPAN BEBERAPA VARITAS KEDELAI ( Glycine Max L. Merril ) TERHADAP INTENSITAS PENGOLAHAN TANAH SAWAH

Paragraf: An experiment of the effect of dose and application time of potassium on yield of sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas (L) Lamb.), had been done since October 11th, 2002 until January 30th 2003 at BPP Mungkid Progowati Village, Mungkid District, Magelang Regency, kind of soil is regosol, pH is 6,8 and the altitude is 295 meters. The experiment method is factorial experiment (4x3) with completely randomized block design and three replications. The first factor is dose of kalium 0, 50, 100 and 150 kg/ha. The second factor is aplications time: 0; 0, 30; 0, 30, 60 days after planting. The result of the research shows that the highest yield quantity of sweet potato (tuber weight per plant) reached at dose of potassium application 78,46 kg/ha. The more application of potassium dose until 150 kg/ha may increase sugar content. Two times potassium application treatment, on 0 and 30 days after planting increases plant length, number of tuber per plot, tuber weight per plant, tuber weight per plot and sugar content. The different dose on different application time of potassium shows regular yield at all parameters.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS DAN SAAT PEMBERIAN KALIUM PADA HASIL UBI JALAR ( Ipomoea batatas (L) Lamb )

Paragraf: An experiment to examine the effect of soaking dura- tion of flute bud of rambutan (Nephelium lappaceum L.) on different kinetin solution concentration to the suc- cess of buddings, was carried out at the Nursery Station of CV. Aneka Tani, Salaman, Magelang, from Mey 1987 until September 1987. The experiment used a factorial method with a Randomized Complete Block Design, consisting of 12 treat- ment combinations with three replications. The first factor was kinetin solution concentration which consist of four levels (K) = 0 ppm, K1 = 5 ppm, K2 = 10 ppm and K3 = 15 ppm) and the second factor was soaking duration of flu- te bud which consist of three levels (P1 = 5 sec, P2 = 10 sec and P3 15 sec). The result of the experiment showed that kinetin concentration did not give a significant effect to all observed components, like the percentage of succeeded bud- ding, shoot length, number of leaves of buds, stem diameter of buds and percentage of seedlings. The soaking duration of flute bud gave a very significant effect the percentage of succeeded budding, with 5 sec. soaking duration of flute bud treatment gave the highest to soaking result compared with that of other soaking duration of flute bud treatments. To the other observation components, soaking duration of flute bud did not give a significant effect. Interaction between K x P influential the percentage succeeded budding, was at K in P1 and P3 level, Pin 1 of K. and K2 level. To the other observation components, inter- action between K x P did not gave a significant effect.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH LAMA PENCELUPAN MATA OKULASI TANAMAN RAMBUTAN ( Nephelium lappaceum L ) PADA BERBAGAI KONSENTRASI LARUTAN KINETIN TERHADAP KEBERHASILAN OKULASINYA

Paragraf: An experiment about of the effect of initial popula- tion and time of emergence of grass (Cyperus rotundus, L.) on growth and yield of onion (Allium cepa fa ascalonicum, L.), had been done since May 20th until August 8th, 2004 in plastic house at Dumpoh Village, Potrobangsan North Magelang District, Magelang City. The altitude is 350 m, kind of soil is latosol and pH 6,5. The method of experiment is factorial (4x3) with completely randomized design and three replications. The first factor is initial population of grass, 0, 5, 10 and 15 plants per polybag. The second factor, is time of emergence of grass one, three and five weeks after sowing. The analysis result shows that increasing initial population until 15 plants grass is able to decrease onion plant height, onion leaves number, fresh weight of onion bulb, weight of dry bulb and length of union roots linearly. Time of emergence of grass five weeks after sowing is able to give the highest onion leaves number, fresh weight of onion bulbs and weight of dry bulbs. The increasing initial population of grass at different time of emergence shows the same result on observed parame- ters.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH POPULASI AWAL DAN SAAT MUNCULNYA TEKI ( Cyperus rotundus, L. ) TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN BAWANG MERAH (Allium cepa fa ascalonicum, L. )

Paragraf: The research is aim to study the effect of time of application and dose of chicken bokhasi on growth of tea cuttings (Camellia sinensis, L.) var TRI 2025. The re- search was done since June 26th 1998 to September 5th 1998, in Adinuso Village, Reban District, Batang Regency. Central Java Province. The soil is latosol with pH 6.0 and altitude 700 metres. The research used factorial experiment (3 x 4) with randomized completly design consisted of three replica- tion. The first factor is time of applications, 14,7 days before planting and at planting. The second factor is dose of bokhasi 0, 125, 250 and 375 g/m2. Result of the research shows application for decom- position process of bokhasi in the soil before planting can increase shoots height, length of roots, fresh weight shoots, fresh weight roots. Higher of bokhasi dose will increase shoots height. leaves area, length of roots fresh weight shoots dry weight shoots. There is interaction time of application and dose of chicken bokhasi on length of roots, however to the other parameters have no interaction and signifi- cant effect.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH DOSIS DAN SAAT PEMBERIAN BOKHASI TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN SETEK TEH (Camellia sinensis, l.) VARITAS TRI 2025

Paragraf: A research about influence of garlic extract concentration and bokashi on growth of vanilla (Vanilla planifolia Andrews) Cuttings has been done on 18th May until 29th August 2003 in BUMD plantation of Temanggung Regency, Karanggedong Village, Ngadirejo Subdistric. The altitude is 625 m. The soil is latosol and it has pH 5,5. The metohd is factorial (3 x 3) with randomized completely block design consists three replication. The fisrt factor is garlic exract concentration is 0,5; 1 and 1,5 cc/5 co water. The second factor is bokashi shikantan, shisako and poepoes bokashi. The result of the research it shows that garlic extract concentration of 1,05 cc/5 cc water can lenghten the bud, the concentrationof 1,05 cc/5 cc water can cause longer root, and the concentration of 1,01 cc/5 cc water can increase the weight of fresh root and the concentration of 1,06 cc/5 cc water can increase the dry weight of root. Bokashi shisako can produce the longer bud, but it has no difference compared to shikantan. Bokashi shisako and poepoes can grow long roots. Bokashi shisako can increase the weight of fresh roots and also the weight of dry roots. The combination between garlic extract and bokashi has no influence forwards all of parameters analyses.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH KONSENTRASI EKSTRAK BAWANG PUTIH DAN MACAM BOKASHI TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN STEK PANILI (Vanilla planifolia Andrews)

Paragraf: The research about heritability and correlation genotype characteristic F3 re- sulted from crossing some varieties of soybean (Glycine max (L) Merrill) had been conducted at Potrobangsan Village, Magelang Utara District, Central Java Pro- vince. It's altitude is 350 metres above sea level with kind of Latosol soil and soil pH is 6,5. The research arranged in random complettly block design consisted of 13 ge- notypes as treatments, with three replicates. The result of research shows: 1. Value of heritability is moderate for plant height, flowering age, plant age. number of fertile nodes, number of filled pods, number of unfilled pods, weight of the 100 dry seed, dry weight of straw. Value heritability is low for weight of dry seeds and fresh weight of straw. 2. Correlation between yield components of number of fertile nodes to number of filled pods is strong where greater number of fertile nodes greater number of filled pods. Correlation between flowering age to number of unfilled pods is weak quicker flowering age greater number of unfilled pods. 3. Genotype Filial third on each dossage of radiation increas plant height and shorten plant age, multiplied number of fertile nodes longer flowering age, de- crease number of filled pods, multiplied number of unfilled pods, increase weight of dry seeds, weight of the 100 dry seed, fresh weight of straw, and dry weight of straw. 4. The highest yield is on galur P (soybean filial third yield, crossed between variety Shakti to dossage of gamma 0,2 kGy and variety Galunggung with the dossage of gamma 0,4 kGy) is 8,26 gram.
Judul: SKRIPSI HERITABILITAS DAN KORELASI SIFAT GENOTIPE F3 HASIL PERSILANGAN BEBERAPA VARITAS KEDELAI (Glycine max (L) Merrill)

Paragraf: The research about frequency of application of DAP and number of branches per plant on yield of water melon (Citrullus vulgaris, Schard) had been done since July 10th to October 17th 2000 at Bojong Village, Mungkid District, Magelang Regency, Central Java. The soil type is regosol and the altitude is 350 meters. The research uses factorial expcriment (4 x 3) in randomized complete block design. with three replications. The first factor is frequency of application of DAP 2, 3, 4 and 5. The second factor is number of branches per plant two and three branches. The result of the research shows that frequency of application non significantly influence female flower initiation, the age of pollination and age of yield, but high significantly increase weight of fruits, weight of fruits per plant, fruit volume and diameter of fruits. Number of branches do not increase female flower initiation, age of the pollination and age of yield, but significantly increase weight of, weight of fruits per plant, the volume of fruits and diameter of fruits. The best fruit quality fruit of water melon is in treatment of five times of frequency and three branches. Increasing DAP frequency on number of branches not significanly influence all of parameters.
Judul: SKRIPSI FREKUENSI PEMBERIAN D.A.P DAN JUMLAH CABANG PER TANAMAN TERHADAP HASIL TANAMAN SEMANGKA

Paragraf: A research entitle the effect of soaking material and duration of soaked on germination and growing of teak seed (Tectona grandis F. Linn) was performed on Nopember 19, 2005 up to February 25, 2006 in Klipang Pesona Asri Blok E 22 Semarang with altitude of 59 m. The method research is using a complete group random design with factorial (2x6). The first factor consist a hot water and H2SO4. The second factor is soaking duration 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 minutes. The research showed soaking matter of H2SO4 5% giving a better response for capacity of germinate of a teak seed equal to 28,89%. While the soaking by using hot water was yielding a lower capacity of germinate equal to 22,78%. The soaking by H2SO4 of 5% during 5 minutes was performed more effective because have a quickest germination rate (12,217 days. Interaction between soaking matter and soaking duration may affect the teak seed growth diameter, height, the number of leaf, the length of root, fresh and dry weight of seedling.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH BAHAN PERENDAM DAN LAMANYA PERENDAMAN TERHADAP PERKECAMBAHAN DAN PERTUMBUHAN BIBIT JATI (Tectona grandis F.Linn)

Paragraf: The research about influence of tipping and foliar fortilizers on the growth vanilla cutting was carried out at Candi- retno Village, Secang District, Magelang City, Central of Java in April until Juli 1991. The soil type Latosol with pll 5,5 and altitude 380 metres sea level. The experiment used the Split Plot Design, according Ran- domized Completely Design (RCD) with consist of two factors, each combination was replicated three time. The first factor is the tipping (X) as the main plot consis- ting of four level: M0 = No tipping M1 = Tipping of 2 weeks before cutting was done M2 = Tipping of 4 weeks before cutting was done M3 = Tipping of 6 weeks before cutting was done, Second factor is the foliar fertilizers (D) as the Sub Plot consisting of three levels: D1 = Supermes with concentration 1 cc/litre water D2 = Margaflor with concentration 1 cc/litre water D3 = Gemari with concentration 1 cc/litre water Result showed the effect of tipping on the number live of cuttings percentage was significant different but tipping did not effect the length of shoots, number of leaves, number of primary roots, fresh weight of shoots and dry weight of shoots. The foliar fertilizers treatment give influence signifi- cant on the shoots height, number of leaves, number of prima- ry of roots, fresh weight of shoots and dry weight of shoots. The tipping and foliar fertilizers no interaction.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH PEMANGKASAN PUCUK DAN PUPUK DAUN TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN TURUS PANILI (Vanilla planifolia Andrews)

Paragraf: The objectives of this research was to study the influence of kind of organic mulch on growth and yield of shallot (Allium cepa L.) varieties. This research was carried out at Kaliputih village, District Ambarawa, in the Region Semarang, from February 29 until May 5, 1996. The soil type used is Latosol, at the elevation 510 meter above sea level. The research methode used factorial (3 x 3) experiment in split plot with randomized complete block design consisted of three replications. Kind of organic mulch as sub plots consisted of three level no mulch, chaff and paddy straw combined with kind of varieties as main plots Bima, Kuning and Samas variety. Results of research indicated that: 1. Samas variety have the highest yield on variables fresh weight of bulbs per hill 69,00 gram and dry weight of bulbs per hill 65,26 gram. Kuning variety have the lowest yield on variables fresh weight of bulbs per hill 38,8 gram and dry weight of bulbs per hill 35,34 gram. 2. The present of organic mulch to increase on diameter of bulb, dry weight of bulbs per hill and dry weight of straw per hill. 3. Paddy straw mulch gives the highest result on diameter of bulb 25,53 mm and dry weight of bulbs per hill 54,47 gram. The lowest yield found on no mulch treatment. 4. The highest mortality percentage found on Kuning variety 27,92% and the lowest mortality percentage found on Samas variety 1,9%.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH MACAM MULSA ORGANIK TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN DAN HASIL BEBERAPA  VARIETAS BAWANG MERAH (Allium cepa L)

Paragraf: To recognize the influence of seed weight and soaking duration on seed growth, was done an expriment in Magelang from December 1987 to March 1988. The experiment used Randomized Complete Block Design (RCBD) which arranged by factorial with two treatment and three replications the objects observed are, seed weight (B) and seed soaking duration (P). First factor, B1 seed weight as 4 to 5 grams, B2 seed weight as more than 5 to 6 grams, B3: seed weight as more than 6 to 7 grams. Se- cond factor, Po seed without soaked, P1 seed soaked in water 48 hours, P2 seed soaked in 96 hours, P3 seed soaked in 144 hours. The result of analysis shows that the best cmbination of treatment is 6 to 7 gram seed weight with duration of soaking is 96 hours (B3P2), it is abtained from the analysis of the power germination of seed rearch to 77,08%. In treatments combination seed weight 4 to 5 gram, with treatments on water soaking as long as 48 hours is reached 43,08% is the worst result of power germination of seed.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH BERAT BENIH DAN LAMA PERENDAMAN BENIH DALAM AIR TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN BIBIT KARET ( Hevea Brasiliensis. MA )

Paragraf: The aim of this research is to study effect of media composition of latosol soil and manur concentration of 11B 101 folior fertilizer on growth of cacao seedling (Thobroma cacao, 1) the research was held december 15th, 1997 until March 25th, 1998. In the location is Jrebeng Village, Wonosegoro Sub district, Boyolali regency, central of java. Type soil latosol with 6,5 altitude 275 Μ. The method which used in the reseach is factorial experiment in randomized completely design, consist at two factors and three replications. First factor is compotision of media 0: 0,75 ; 1 : 1,5 ; 1 : 2,25. Second factors is concentrations of HB101 foliar fertilizer 0:0,5 ; 2,5:3,75 cc/1 of water. The result of reseach shows that compositions media treatment is significant on all parameters, while concentrations of HB 101 foiar fertilizer treatment is high significant on leaves number, fresh weight and is significant on the sedling height, the tap root ang is non significant on stem diameter.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGARUH PERBANDINGAN KOMBINASI MEDIA KOMPOS SAMPAH KOTA KONSENTRASI PUPUK HB 101 PADA TANAH LATOSOL TERHADAP PERTUMBUHAN BIBIT KAKAO ( Theobroma Cacao L. )

Paragraf: The research of the effect of dosages OST fertilizer to the variety of plant of soy bean (Glycine max L. Merrill) to three varieties are of Wilis, Tidar and Merbabu, the treat- ment of dosages OST fertilizer, there were non fertilizer, 23, 46 and 69 gram/ polybag. Paragraf: The experiment was to aim is to know the effect of TSP dosage and cover crop to the yield of green pea (Phaseolus radiatus L.) No. 129 variety. Paragraf: The experiment about of the effect of seedling age and bokashi Shikantan composition on yield of cauliflower (Brassica oleracea subvar. cauliflower DC.), have been done since May 11th until June 26th, 2003 in Sukorini Village, Muntilan District, Magelang Regency. The second factors, medium composition= soil:bokashi Shikantan = 1:0,25; 1:0,50; 1:0,75 and 1:1,00. The analysis result shows that 23 days seedling able to fasten flower initiation, increasing leaves number, increasing flower weight and volume. The best yield given at age of seedling 23 days and composition of media soil:bokashi Shikantan 1:0,75.
